notes.title: Update 1.8.3
notes.content:
- bug fixes
- reworked user interface
- improved camera control

notes.title: Update - Camera
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Top view camera added, now player can choose between two types of camera, top view and bird view.
[*] Improved animation and display of traps and blocks.
[*] Adjusted the maximum number of moves to get a trophy on some levels. It is now harder to get a trophy.
[*] Fixed sound issue with female human characters.
[*] Fixed some small bugs that did not prevent the game from working.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39983652/86593de91c9d58323af65335071812ca38fe367d.gif[/img]

notes.title: Minor Udpate - Cursor
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Adding a new cursor.
[*]Addition of a shortcut (the R key on the keyboard) allowing you to restart a level without going through the menu.
[*]Added a checkbox in the menu to enable / disable automatic selection. When automatic selection is enabled, an object is now automatically re-selected after its movement, except in certain cases (example: after deletion).
[/list]

notes.title: Update - Trophy
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Adding trophy on each level, a trophy can be obtained if the level is completed with a set number of moves.
[*]Addition of an interface allowing to redo the previous levels.
[*]Addition of life points on objects to limit their number of movements, when the life point is at 0, the object turns into a cone and can no longer be moved.
[*]Improved zoom and camera location.
[*]Improved menu interface.
[*]Fixed movement of humans.
[*]Fixed some levels.
[*]Fixed some bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update - Colored Earth
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Change in the representation of the ground, the earth and the sky are more colorful, with grass, flowers, trees and water.
[*]Changed the color of some objects, especially floors, walls, windows and doors.
[*]Added animation effect to doors and windows when walls appear and disappear.
[*]Modification and improvement of certain levels, correction of dialogues.
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39983652/d740ba4545bf00b09b9d09cb3b386c7d70555348.gif[/img]

notes.title: Minor Update - Human
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added an interface showing the order of human movement, this interface only displays if the cursor is on a human or if the humans are moving, and if there is more than one human on a level.
[*]Fixed the movement of objects larger than 1x1, the objects in question, when placed on the Z axis, could not be moved with the right mouse click method.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update - Wall
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where some objects could be moved through walls.
[*]Fixed a bug where some items got stuck when going to the next level, it was necessary to restart the level.
[*]Improved wall display algorithm, a wall will no longer be displayed if an object is behind it.
[*]In dream mode, a wall will be hidden if it is near the little chameleon.
[*]Small correction on the tutorial at the beginning.
[*]X or V is now the default way to rotate the camera, instead of using the mouse and the edge of the screen, can be changed in the menu.
[*]Dialogs will no longer appear when restarting a level, except for tutorials. A story mode button is already available in the menu, and allows you to activate or deactivate the dialogues in the game.
[*]The zoom will be reset and will no longer be available when activating dream mode.
[*]Background music loops have been reduced.
[*]Improved sheep movement.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update - Fire
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when the table catches fire and the player restarts the level.
[*]Windows and doors turn black when there is fire on the corresponding square.
[*]Fixed a bug concerning the target box, an object was not displayed correctly on some levels.
[*]Fixed the way Leon appears in dream mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update - Dream
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added a dream mode that allows you to move freely on the map.
[*]Fixed a bug in the main menu where the texts are not translated correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor update - Steam Achievements
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where some players could not get Steam Achievements.
[/list]

notes.title: Level loading
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when loading a level.
[*]Fixed some bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Game release is coming soon!
notes.content:
The release date of the game is fast approaching, a few fixes and adjustments still need to be made to provide the best possible experience for the player. And here are some changes for those who already have the preview version of the game:
[list]
[*]All achievements can now be done.
[*]Added a pop-up when an achievement has been unlocked.
[*]The display method of blocked objects has been reworked.
[*]Added a button that toggles camera control mode, by default camera control is done using mouse cursor and screen edge, now X and V keys also allow to rotate the camera.
[*]Added a button that allows to activate or deactivate the story mode.
[*]Added a button that allows to activate or deactivate the tutorials.
[*]Fixed a bug on the button that allows to activate or deactivate the music.
[*]Fixed other minor bugs.
[/list]
ːsteamhappyː
